crossRefs.note: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.
I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness…
Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me…
God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of…
I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.
Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians…
that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
“I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

translations.web: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.
translations.bsb: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.
translations.kjv: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.
translations.asv: Jehovah is a man of war: Jehovah is his name.
